why: A July 2024 preprint by Misa Nakanishi (arXiv:2407.00646) claims to prove the Lovász conjecture for the case of connected vertex-transitive graphs with an odd number of vertices, and a June 2026 preprint (arXiv:2606.09742) claims further progress toward the general conjecture via sublinear expanders; both are unread claims, not verified proofs.
